title: console avatar menu: a hidden app that shares its package with the package's first app opens the first app instead of itself
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect, found beside the clauses (studio-authoring.app-and-nav-properties acceptance[4]), reach: the console avatar menu, measured 3 times.
Business reason: `hidden: true` keeps an app off the launcher but in the avatar menu, the one door left to reach it (a settings-style app shipped beside a package's main app). When the hidden app shares its package with the package's first app, the menu entry opens the first app, so the hidden app cannot be reached from the menu at all.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then a `domain:ui` implementer in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx`. QA suggestion only: p3.
Duplicate search: `hidden app avatar menu` → 26 hits, all QA run records or unrelated; `appAddressSegment` → 2 hits (#28890 ⌘K record URL, #26183 sidebar app ids, both closed and different paths).
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1 — 16 cards from QA run #29002 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

## Reproduction
1. A writable package `com.qa.r6nav` with `qsixn_app` (first, not hidden) and `qsixn_hidden_app` (`hidden: true`), both published.
2. As a member (or admin), open `/_console/apps/com.qa.r6nav` → avatar button → menu item "R6 Hidden App".

Expected: lands in R6 Hidden App (`/_console/apps/qsixn_hidden_app/…`, which renders it when typed directly). Actual: lands in `/_console/apps/com.qa.r6nav/qsixn_project/view/closed_projects`, the first app. Reproduced 3 times (member twice on fresh contexts).

## Mechanism (suspected)
The hidden-apps `DropdownMenuItem` in `AppHeader.tsx` navigates to `/apps/` plus `appRouteSegment(app) ?? app.name`, which is the package id. `appAddressSegment(apps, app)` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/appRoute.ts` exists for this; its docblock says the name is the only address that reaches a package's non-first app.

QA-source: #29002 · studio-authoring.app-and-nav-properties · observed beside the clauses
